notes.title: Adventure Of Thieves Now Available on Mac !!
notes.content:
We have just released the mac version of Adventure Of Thieves. 
The pvp server in this mac version is the same with the windows version,
so the mac players can also attack the windows player's dungeon and vice versa.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26000524/7682a590f2650f223f00f85e4e3f752f7bb850e4.png[/img]
